title: RFK Jr. Drew $4 Million in Book Advances From Publisher Who Also Monetized MAHA
summary: A new disclosure also shows $210,000 in consulting fees paid to Cheryl Hines, the health secretary’s wife, by one of several MAHA-affiliated groups capitalizing from his agenda.
